meta.name: InRealLife
meta.description: InRealLifeasks: What exactly is the Internet and what is it doing to our children? Taking us on a journey ranging from the bedrooms of British teenagers to the explosive world of Silicon Valley, filmmaker Beeban Kidron suggests that rather than the promise of free and open connectivity, young people are increasingly ensnared in a commercial world. And as this is explained,InRealLifeasks if we can afford to stand by while our children, trapped in their 24/7 connectivity, are being outsourced to the web.
